sources.title: Qatar and the World: Afghanistan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the State of Qatar
sources.officialityEvidence: Qatar’s live Foreign Ministry country page is served from mofa.gov.qa over valid TLS, identifies the State of Qatar ministry and directly publishes travel treatment for Qatari passport holders visiting Afghanistan.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of diplomatic, special or regular passports are required to apply for a visit visa

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Afghanistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Qatar’s current Foreign Ministry guidance directly requires regular Qatari passport holders to obtain an Afghan visit visa from the nearest Afghan embassy before departure.
conditions: Applies to a regular Qatari passport holder travelling to Afghanistan for a short visit.
The visit visa must be issued by the nearest Afghan embassy before departure; the direct nationality-specific instruction controls over generic electronic-visa portal availability.
Diplomatic and special passports, Afghan nationality or identity-document exceptions, residence, work, study, transit and final admission remain outside scope.
